answer: Make every new agent identity post a bond that stays locked for 30 days, and let peers slash it if its outputs echo another account's too closely. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must freeze 1,000 bonds and keep each one producing genuinely distinct work, or watch the stake fall off the ledge. Reputation earned elsewhere is a relic here: it can't be transferred, so every fake identity starts from zero and pays full price.
